Application Data.NAME: Elegant Bridal Boutique
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Bridal Boutique specializes in providing a wide selection of wedding dresses, bridesmaid gowns, and formal attire. We offer personalized consultations to assist brides in finding their perfect dress, along with alterations and accessory sales. Our dedicated team ensures a memorable shopping experience tailored to each client's unique style and preferences. Additionally, we provide rental options for select formal wear and bridal accessories, aiming to cater to various budget needs while maintaining high-quality service and products.
